QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_64

question.text: An AIF must complete at least how long from First Close before being required to provide data to Benchmarking Agencies?

answer.text: At least one year from First Close

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that a Category III AIF that has completed a minimum of one year from First Close shall report performance-related, cash-flow, and valuation data to Benchmarking Agencies. Box 6.2(b) similarly says AIFs and Schemes that have completed at least one year from First Close shall provide such information. The Trap: Three or six months is shorter than the one-year requirement; three years exceeds the cadence prescribed by the workbook. Note: Per workbook pages 230-231.
